listing.name: Brandon's Sci-fi Faction Flag Pack 1.3 - SERIES 2 Released
listing.summary: This mod adds a bunch of flags from various sci-fi factions.
listing.aiSummary: Adds faction flags from various science fiction franchises to the game.

description: Adds faction flags from various science fiction franchises, including Starcraft, Star Wars, Star Trek, Halo, and Fallout. The pack includes two series of flags covering numerous factions such as the Terran Dominion, Rebel Alliance, Klingon Empire, and Covenant.
